name: Monthly freelancer books closer
why: Runs a monthly close for a freelancer: sorted transactions, a budget check and the tax set aside, matching the month-end close workflow.

name: Monthly profit close
why: Turns the month's reconciled sales and costs into a profit and loss set against last month, the last step of month-end close.

name: Expense report builder
why: Builds an expense report from receipts with a reason for each line and gaps to fix, like the expense sort prompt.

name: Find duplicate and unused business subscriptions
why: Finds the subscription leaks the transaction categorisation skill flags and lists renewals to act on.

name: Check supplier invoices before approval
why: Matches supplier invoices before payment, a simple control against duplicate payments and payment diversion.

name: Excel table join reconciler
why: Reconciles two tables on matching keys, useful for bank-to-ledger and payout-to-deposit matching in a spreadsheet.

name: Weekly invoice and cash chaser
why: Keeps money owed to the business moving each week with reminders for the owner to send.

name: Tax set-aside planner
why: Turns the accountant's quoted rate into a set-aside rule, the same approach as the tax set-aside prompt.

name: Self-assessment tax return checklist
why: Lists the records and questions a UK sole trader gathers for the accountant, a companion to the year-end handover.

name: Build a monthly P&L and know your real margin
why: Builds a monthly profit and loss with true unit costs for sellers whose payouts the payout reconciliation skill has cleaned.
